sourceResearch.importantFinding: The DataMeet AC boundary file is rejected for production geometry (4,182 features, 4,102 unique state/AC keys, 80 extra duplicate rows, 6 invalid geometries, 34 null AC names, and source README warnings). Five ECI-portal-derived secondary GeoJSON candidates match their expected seat counts but have 23 invalid geometries and duplicate West Bengal constituency name; none is promoted to OFFICIAL. The official TGRAC Telangana layer returns 119 features but has one invalid geometry and TOT_P/TOT_M/TOT_F all zero, so its demographic attributes are rejected. The Survey of India village index lists 27 archives; 14 were acquired and audited (71,484 features, 37 invalid geometries, one CRS metadata conflict), 13 remain unavailable. ECI index returned HTTP 406, guessed ECI JS endpoints returned HTTP 404, and Census PCA direct downloads failed. No canonical database writes were made.
sourceResearch.geometryTransformation: No derived geometry accepted as official. Five secondary ECI-portal-derived GeoJSON candidates were hashed and audited; 23 invalid geometries and a duplicate West Bengal constituency name prevent direct production use. The official Telangana GIS response is retained as a geometry candidate only; its population attributes are rejected. Primary national AC geometry and official Form 20/PCA data remain unresolved.

knownDefectFoundDuringResumption.description: Migration 068 defines criminal-disclosure counts as NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 and data_status as DEFAULT OFFICIAL, which can fabricate zero counts or elevate source-less rows to OFFICIAL. It also omits the constituency_id foreign key despite describing canonical constituency linkage.
knownDefectFoundDuringResumption.remediation: Migration 072 removes these defaults, nulls source-less default zeros, demotes unsupported OFFICIAL rows to UNKNOWN, requires source evidence for OFFICIAL, and adds a restrictive canonical constituency FK.
